summary: A trust layer is assembled from traces, evaluations, regression gates and review policy; no single observability product proves that an output is safe or correct.

items.text: LangSmith: traces, datasets, offline experiments and online evaluators connect observed runs to repeatable quality checks.
Arize Phoenix: open-source tracing and evaluations expose model calls, tool steps and evaluator results for inspection.
Langfuse: trace, prompt, evaluation, token and cost records can provide the evidence projection behind a review queue.
OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions: vendor-neutral trace attributes can reduce dependence on one observability backend.
